items.title: Choose an aspect ratio
items.description: Select a square, portrait or landscape format for your composition.

items.title: Set a target resolution
items.description: Choose 1K, 2K or 4K. Actual output depends on the generation service.

items.title: Download or copy a link
items.description: Download the generated image or copy its image URL.

items.title: See the credit cost
items.description: The tool shows the credits needed per generation and your available balance.

items.title: Review your result
items.description: Text, details and composition may need another attempt. Check the output before using it.

items.title: Does loading an example use credits?
items.description: No. Example buttons only fill in the prompt and settings. Generation starts when you press the generate button.

items.title: Do I need to sign in?
items.description: Yes. Sign in before generating. The tool displays your account credit balance.

items.title: Which aspect ratios are supported?
items.description: Choose square, portrait or landscape formats from the current aspect-ratio menu in the tool.

items.title: What if the result is not what I expected?
items.description: Specify the subject, composition, lighting and style more clearly, and remove conflicting instructions. Another generation may require credits.

items.title: Can I publish the result immediately?
items.description: Check image details, factual accuracy and relevant rights before publishing. See the terms of service for applicable conditions.
